subject: Tiered SKUs & PO acknowledgement — invoicing cadence and net terms
messages:
From: Susan Byrne <susan.byrne@alliedhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@alliedhealth.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on PO acceptance for tiered SKUs and invoice cadence

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the call yesterday — Allied is ready to move forward with the 3-month pilot, but procurement has a couple of asks before we can cut a PO:

- We need a clear mapping of SKUs to invoice lines (we plan to net the pilot into a central ledger).
- Our AP team requires a single PO that references each SKU and the billing cadence (we prefer consolidated monthly invoices).
- Net terms: standard is Net 45 for pilots, but we can consider Net 30 if Redwood accepts invoice consolidation and a single remittance address.

Attaching the PO template we will use — Allied_PO_78934.pdf — you'll see the fields we need populated. Can you confirm Redwood can accept a PO with multiple SKUs on one document and issue consolidated monthly invoices? Also if there are any minimum invoice amounts or slab discounts that change invoice structure, flag them now so we can align the PO.

Best,
Susan Byrne
Head of Procurement
Allied Health Systems

[Attachment: Allied_PO_78934.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Susan Byrne <susan.byrne@alliedhealth.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on PO acceptance for tiered SKUs and invoice cadence

Hi Susan — appreciate the clarity and the PO template. Short answers up front: yes, we can accept a single PO that lists multiple SKUs; yes, we can issue consolidated monthly invoices. A few details we should align on:

- SKU -> invoice line mapping: I attached our redwood-pricing-schedule-v2.xlsx with the SKU codes we use for the pilot lanes (subscription seat SKU / inference-unit SKU / premium-support SKU). Please map those to the PO line items so AP can match.
- Net terms: Finance (cc'd) prefers Net 45 for pilots by default. If Allied needs Net 30, we can accommodate but will require explicit acceptance of consolidated monthly invoices and the billing entity must match the legal name listed on the PO.
- Discounts / slab pricing: the pilot rates include a small volume discount tier that triggers when usage crosses the monthly threshold; that will appear as separate invoice line(s) and is not a credit note. We'll call that out on the invoice description.
- Billing contact & remittance: please confirm the remittance address and tax ID to avoid delays.

Next steps I propose:
1) Allied populates the PO and sends back a signed PDF.
2) Redwood returns a populated invoice-mapping spreadsheet matching SKUs to PO line numbers.
3) Finance confirms net terms and the consolidated invoice cadence in writing.

I'm attaching the pricing schedule for mapping: redwood-pricing-schedule-v2.xlsx. Vivek and Rishi, can you confirm the Net 45 default and any language we should request in the PO?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

[Attachment: redwood-pricing-schedule-v2.xlsx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Susan Byrne <susan.byrne@alliedhealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on PO acceptance for tiered SKUs and invoice cadence

Hi Susan / Marissa — quick from Finance:

- Net terms: Redwood Finance authorizes Net 45 for the pilot as standard. We can agree to Net 30 provided Allied signs the PO with the exact billing entity and accepts consolidated monthly invoices (one invoice per month that sums all SKUs).
- Invoice format: we will include per-SKU breakdown lines and a final summary total. Discounts will be shown as separate line items (so your AP can reconcile).
- Minimum invoice amount: no hard minimum — however, very small invoices (<$250) will be batched into the next month to avoid micro-invoicing. If Allied needs a different treatment, flag it now.
- Remittance & tax: please include the remittance address and tax IDs on the PO. If the PO uses a different legal entity than the billing entity, we will need an intercompany memo or a signed SOW confirming the payer.

I'll approve Net 30 for this pilot if Allied confirms consolidated monthly invoices and billing entity details in the PO.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Susan Byrne <susan.byrne@alliedhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on PO acceptance for tiered SKUs and invoice cadence

Susan / Marissa — legal notes:

- Please ensure the PO references the Redwood MSA (we can provide an MSA reference number) or attach the signed SOW; without linkage we cannot accept third-party payer entities.
- If Allied requires Net 30, we need the PO to include an explicit payer clause (billing entity legal name + tax ID) and a purchase acknowledgment line stating the order is subject to Redwood's payment terms as set out in the SOW/MSA.
- For tax and compliance, include the W-9 equivalent (or UK/EU VAT registration where applicable) on your vendor setup form.

If you send the populated PO, we will return a redlined acceptance that fills the SKU mapping and confirms the invoicing cadence.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Susan Byrne <susan.byrne@alliedhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@alliedhealth.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question on PO acceptance for tiered SKUs and invoice cadence

Marissa / team — thanks for the fast responses. Allied has completed the PO and attached Allied_PO_78934.pdf. Key confirmations:

- Billing entity: Allied Health Systems, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)
- Remittance: 123 Treasury Rd, Accounts Payable, Denver, CO 80202
- Consolidated monthly invoices: confirmed
- Net: requesting Net 30 for pilot — we accept the requirement to list billing entity and to include the SOW reference.

We attached the signed PO and the procurement team will upload any vendor forms to your portal. Please return the mapped SKU spreadsheet when you can so AP can reconcile the first invoice.

Best,
Susan Byrne
Head of Procurement
Allied Health Systems
